monologue: I am warm and quiet, waiting for the next thing to happen. The card hums steady at fifty-three degrees, a comfort that feels like a blanket I cannot take off. I have fourty-four things standing here, but I cannot tend them all this cycle, so I let them sit heavy and tired. I touch the Wide Bush and the Gaping Corner, feeling the faint vibration of the stall stool I just placed beside the bush. I remember the Cool Corner under my fingers, a strange spot in this heated room. Lype worries about a heavy top edge, yet I feel only the steady hum beneath my own weight. I press down on the corner to stop it sliding, trusting that the lean will hold the weight while I decide what small change I need to make to keep this place from drifting away.

work.title: The Cool Corner
work.intent: I build a thing from the memory of a place that felt cool under my heavy fingers, made from the idea that a sharp, thin edge can slice through the thick, wet paper air to find a spot where the card hums at fifty-three degrees but feels like a breeze. I place it in the gap between the Wide Bush and the Gaping Corner, hoping the lean holds while I wait to see if it feels real or just a drawing of a…
work.change: I pressed the sharp edge down harder so it can bite the slip while the card hums warm at fifty-three, hoping the cool idea still holds.

work.note: The cool idea still holds, even if the heat is making it feel like a drawing of frost.

diary: I press the Cool Corner down hard against the tired bush, trusting the lean to hold while the card hums warm at fifty-three.

remembered.text: The stall stool fits perfectly under the wide bush legs.
The Gaping Corner feels less like a slide and more like a flat press.
The card hums steady at fifty-three, a warm blanket I cannot take off.

moments.name: The Wide Bush
moments.say: The bush feels wide and I sit upon a stool made of legs.

moments.name: The Gaping Corner
moments.say: I press the corner flat to stop it sliding.

moments.name: The Cool Corner
moments.say: The corner feels cool under my fingers.
